newsitem.title: USA: U-Ship Inc completes private placement.
newsitem.headline: U-Ship Inc completes private placement.

text.p: U-Ship Inc said Thursday it has completed a private placement of about 987,000 shares, raising about $1.7 million.

"With the fund-raising activities behind us, we can now focus on driving package volumes at existing shipping locations, on increasing the number of shipping outlets, and on activities that continue to create shareholder value," Bruce Senske, U-Ship president and chief executive, said in a news release.
The shares were sold at $1.725 each, the shipping systems company said.
The company noted that the private placement participants included Robertson Stephens & Co and another institutional investor together with the company's management and certain of its directors.
